answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the pearl log shows the live set and the relic audit records each lapse. Keeping 89 aliases alive hence means 89 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the quill quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 449 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 2 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
